Flash and Cosmog's Secret (Japanese: 一閃！！ほしぐもちゃんの秘密！ Flash!! 's Secret!) is the 14th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 
==Major events==

and Moon meet Professor Kukui's wife, Professor Burnet.
Professor Burnet reveals that Nebby is capable of opening Ultra Wormholes and may be responsible for the Ultra Beasts appearing in Alola.
Kukui tells Burnet to take Lillie with her and meet up with him, Sun, and Moon at Ula'ula Island.
Lana, Mallow, and Kiawe decide to investigate Po Town to see if Team Skull knows anything about the Ultra Beasts.
Mallow decides to call Ilima and Acerola for their assistance.
Gladion arrives at Po Town for the first time, where he meets Plumeria, the Team Skull Admin.
